skill.summary: AI前沿动态和ClawHub技能推荐报告生成器。自动搜索最新AI新闻、对比ClawHub上用户未安装的Skills，生成结构化报告。支持web search和ClawHub搜索。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-trends-reporter.
- Automatically generates structured reports with the latest AI news and ClawHub skill recommendations.
- Supports web search via Brave Search API and ClawHub search.
- Recommends high-rated, uninstalled ClawHub Skills tailored to user needs.
- Flexible report types and focus areas available through parameters.
